interpretations.statement: Growth hit the founder's capacity: orders arrived faster than one home kitchen could fill them.

limits.text: A single documented case; nothing here shows the pattern holds for any other operation.

interpretations.rationale: The reported first-year sales and the reported daily output of the kitchen are what the reading rests on.

interpretations.statement: Hiring would have solved the problem.
interpretations.rationale: The material records no hiring decision and no result of one.

interpretations.statement: Readers who bake at home will hit the same ceiling.
interpretations.rationale: The kitchen's recorded daily output is what the reading carries onto the reader.

limits.text: One case, one founder, one kitchen, and no second source.

reader_connection.text: The configured audience runs operations where one person's capacity is the binding constraint, which is the constraint this case records.
